summary: Destructor-style cleanup of a standard linked list. Walks every node from the head at this+0x0; for each node it advances to the node's next pointer (+0x4), frees the node's data via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the node's flag byte (+0x8) is set and the data pointer (+0x0) is non-null, then frees the node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf in the loop continuation. After the traversal zeroes all four list-struct fields (this+0x0, this+0x4, this+0x8, this+0xC) and returns the last FreeWrapper_7bcf result.

local_names.this: linked-list container: head at +0x0, with three further state fields zeroed on teardown
local_names.node: current node being freed; data at +0x0, next at +0x4, flag byte at +0x8
local_names.result: return value of the final FreeWrapper_7bcf call (undefined when the list was empty)

operations.description: Traverse the whole list: start at the head pointer this+0x0, and for each node capture the next pointer (+0x4) before freeing.
For each node, free its data (+0x0) with FreeWrapper_7bcf only when the node's flag byte at +0x8 is set and the data pointer is non-null.
Free each node structure itself with FreeWrapper_7bcf (the loop-continuation step); its return value is kept as the final result.
After the traversal, zero the list head at this+0x0.
Zero the three remaining list-struct state fields at this+0x4, this+0x8 and this+0xC.
Return the result of the last FreeWrapper_7bcf call; when the list was empty the value is the uninitialized result of the loop variable.
Invoked by sub_57BCE0 as part of list teardown; the owning type is not resolved in this packet.
